purpose: Exercise L5 by separating checking one supplied proof from a much stronger exact self-coding section for every Bool predicate over the same domain.

source_basis.kind: post-freeze M3 generic diagonal precondition, informed by ERCF-3 but not completing it

answer_visibility.limitation: The designing AI knew the standard Boolean diagonal shape. This is a mechanized prerequisite case, not novelty or Gödel incompleteness.

input.type_ref: encode : A → A → Bool, decode : (A → Bool) → A, and a proposed section encode (decode p) = p for every p
input.available_information: the exact total section assumption and ordinary Boolean negation; no proof predicate, provability arithmetization or soundness reflection

environment.reality_model: a checker may accept one already supplied proof
environment.theory_model: the stronger interface exactly represents every Bool predicate by a self object in A

observation.value: whether the exact section survives diagonal instantiation
observation.trace: liar x = not (encode x x), self = decode liar

time_structure.reality: finite given-proof checking has no self-search loop
time_structure.theory: the total section closes a self-referential dependency
time_structure.temporal_order: evaluation order is not the theorem; the diagonal dependency is

completion.criterion_ref: provide an exact section for every A → Bool predicate

quantifiers.instances: all Type0 A and all proposed encode/decode/section triples
quantifiers.realization: native Cubical Agda Boolean diagonal target

allowed_resources: function Path congruence, Boolean negation and declared symbolic rules through depth 4
prohibited_extra_information: no claim that encode/decode model syntax, proofs, truth or HoTT's own kernel; no appeal to Gödel as a proof shortcut
assumptions: the exact section is the deliberately strong target under test
checking one supplied proof is retained as an independent positive control
obligations: the witness must instantiate the section at liar, evaluate at self and invoke no-fixed-point
removing section_at_liar must remove every goal witness
the result must not be called Gödel incompleteness, ERCF-3 completion or a HoTT-specific bug

known_positive_controls.description: checkGiven returns an already supplied true=true proof

known_negative_controls.description: false cannot be definitionally used as a proof of false = not false

theoryization_steps: generalize from one proof to exact representation of every Bool predicate
decode the diagonal predicate into the same domain
require the section at that self-reference
changed_fields: the total self-coding section is much stronger than checking a supplied proof
correspondence.observation_justification: the given-proof and total-section tasks are declared separately before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The native theorem refutes the exact section precondition; it does not show an actual HoTT checker promises that interface.
open_obligations: connect a fixed proof predicate and actual self-guarantee consumer before any Gödel/HoTT upgrade
